# lmw post edit

Replace the text of one of your posts (asks for confirmation)

### Synopsis

Replace the text of one of your posts. The new text replaces all of the old
one, and mentions in the old text are not kept; images and other media stay.

```
lmw post edit POST [flags]
```

### Examples

```
  lmw post edit urn:li:activity:7123456789012345678 --text-file fixed.txt
```

### Options

```
  -h, --help               help for edit
      --text string        post text
      --text-file string   file with the post text
```
